reviews.author: _Lee Eung
reviews.text:
I went to Hapjeong Prism Hall, and it was better than I expected.
The location is near Exit 3 of Hapjeong Station. You have to go into an alley, so you might get a little lost if you go there for the first time. But you will know right away when you see the sign. The exterior is not flashy, but it has the perfect ‘performance hall’ atmosphere.

The inside is smaller than expected, but the structure is concentrated. The distance between the stage and the audience is close, and the lighting is good so you can see faces well. The color of the lighting is not excessive, so it is less tiring on the eyes, and the color temperature is clear even when taking photos or videos.

The sound was pretty good. The bass does not bleed and the vocals are heard clearly. Especially at band performances, the bass and drums are full, but it doesn't feel stuffy. However, the front row is a bit noisy. The middle was the best balance.

The audience atmosphere was free and lively. It felt like everyone really came to see the performance. I liked the looks on everyone's faces when they left after the performance.
The bathroom was okay, and there was a bit of a line. Drinks can be purchased at the entrance and payment can be made by credit card.

Overall, it was a small but open space where you could feel the temperature of a live performance.
To sum it up in one line, “A concert hall that is small in scale but big in heart.”

reviews.text:
A collection of CGV Yeonnam discount tips if you like movies!
Watch Jojo’s movie for only 10,000 won with the SKT VIP 1+1 coupon!

When watching the CGV Yeonnam Jojo Movie (10:30 a.m.), you can watch the movie at a really economical price by using the SKT VIP membership 1+1 discount coupon. The basic Jojo price is around 10,000 won, and you can pay the same price for up to one person, making it the best benefit for dates or watching a movie with friends.

SKT VIP can use a 1+1 coupon at CGV for free admission 3 times a year and 9 times a year on both weekdays and weekends. Up to 4,000 won discount is provided for each ticket purchase, so the burden of movie costs is minimal.

Based on CGV Yeonnam branch, early morning (6:00~10:00) is 10,000 won (weekdays)/11,000 won (weekends), brunch (10:01~13:00) is 12,000 won (weekdays)/15,000 won (weekends), and regular (13:01~) is 14,000~15,000 won. You can also take advantage of movie discounts from various card companies (credit/check card), regular events, Culture Day (5,000 won discount on tickets on the last Wednesday of every month), preferential/senior fares, and 1,000 won discount for rows A to B.

These days, in addition to telecommunication company promotions, you can watch the event at a cheaper price by applying on-site discount coupons and membership app benefits. If you are a VIP, you can receive similar benefits from CGV, Lotte Cinema, and Megabox, and you can use it on both weekdays and weekends, so it is recommended to keep it!

reviews.text: The facility is one of the cleanest coin karaoke rooms I've ever been to! It's good to have a part-time schedule, and the sound is also great ♥ (The echo and music aren't too loud, so I can hear my voice well) I just picked one of the karaoke bars near the restaurant today, and I was very satisfied. I'll go here again when I go to Hongdae ~♥
